items.claim: I could use 4 of 9 parking lots.
items.reason: Parking quality lists 9 total lots and 4 usable lots.

items.claim: On a typical weekday across the usable lots, occupancy was lowest at 3:00 at 25.4% and highest at 12:00 at 43.5%.
items.reason: The parking typical weekday profile bottoms at 3:00 with 25.4% and peaks at 12:00 with 43.5%.

items.claim: Weekend patterns differed by lot.
items.reason: The pooled parking test says weekend effects differ between lots.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz was fuller on weekends by 7.8 percentage points.
items.reason: Its weekend effect is +7.8 percentage points and significant.

items.claim: Tiefgarage Friedensplatz and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus were emptier by 13.7 and 15.6 percentage points.
items.reason: Their weekend effects are -13.7 and -15.6 percentage points, both significant.

items.claim: Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Hotel Maritim's weekend effect is not significant.

items.claim: Compared with July, only Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim became fuller, by 13.9 percentage points.
items.reason: Hotel Maritim is the only parking lot with a significant increase, at +13.9 percentage points.

items.claim: The 95% interval was 10.9 to 17.0 percentage points.
items.reason: That is Hotel Maritim's 95% confidence interval for the adjusted shift.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz, Tiefgarage Friedensplatz, and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus showed no measurable change.
items.reason: All three lots are listed as having no significant month-on-month change.

items.claim: I could use 15 of 18 charging stations.
items.reason: EV charging quality lists 15 usable stations out of 18 total.

items.claim: On a typical weekday, charging point occupancy was lowest at 4:00 at 8.3% and highest at 11:00 at 30.9%.
items.reason: The typical weekday profile bottoms at 04:00 with 8.3% and peaks at 11:00 with 30.9%.

items.claim: The weekend effect was mixed across stations, so there was no single citywide weekend pattern.
items.reason: The pooled test says weekend effects differ between stations, and significant station effects go in both positive and negative directions.

items.claim: Some stations were busier on weekends, others were less busy.
items.reason: There are significant positive weekend effects at some stations and significant negative weekend effects at others.

items.claim: Among the comparable stations, one became busier, one became less busy, and eleven showed no measurable change from July.
items.reason: The comparison summary lists 1 higher, 1 lower, and 11 with no significant change among 13 comparable stations.

items.claim: Breiter Weg 203 became busier by 17.9 percentage points, from 25.6% to 44.6%.
items.reason: Breiter Weg 203 has a significant adjusted shift of +17.9 points, with mean occupancy rising from 25.6% to 44.6%.

items.claim: Am Blauen Bock 3 became less busy by 22.1 percentage points, from 42.6% to 20.0%, with a 95% interval of -31.2 to -13.1 percentage points.
items.reason: Am Blauen Bock 3 has a significant adjusted shift of -22.1 points, means of 42.6% and 20.0%, and a 95% interval from -31.2 to -13.1.

items.claim: The busiest stations by time with no point free were Breiter Weg 203 at 31.0%, Hegelstraße 4 at 23.4%, and Hegelstraße 19 at 17.0%.
items.reason: These are the three highest busy_all_points_pct values across the EV charging stations.

items.claim: For NO2, I could use all four stations.
items.reason: All four NO2 stations are listed as usable.

items.claim: A typical weekday fell to 10.8 µg/m³ at 4:00 and rose to 25.5 µg/m³ at 9:00.
items.reason: The NO2 typical weekday trough is 10.8 at 4:00 and peak is 25.5 at 9:00.

items.claim: Weekend NO2 was lower at City Tunnel by 9.3 µg/m³ and at Guericke Strasse by 4.8 µg/m³, while Schleinufer and West showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: City Tunnel and Guericke Strasse have significant negative weekend effects, while Schleinufer and West do not.

items.claim: No NO2 station exceeded the EU hourly limit of 200 µg/m³.
items.reason: Each NO2 station has 0 hours over the EU hourly limit of 200 µg/m³.

items.claim: The WHO daily guideline of 25 µg/m³ was exceeded on 17 days at City Tunnel, 3 days at Guericke Strasse, and 3 days at Schleinufer.
items.reason: Those WHO daily-guideline exceedance counts match the NO2 thresholds data.

items.claim: West had no exceedance.
items.reason: West has 0 exceedances in the NO2 thresholds data.

items.claim: Compared with July, NO2 was more polluted at City Tunnel by 6.8 µg/m³, at Guericke Strasse by 4.7 µg/m³, and at West by 1.8 µg/m³.
items.reason: All three stations have significant positive adjusted shifts, which means more polluted NO2.

items.claim: Schleinufer showed no measurable change.
items.reason: Schleinufer's adjusted month-on-month NO2 shift is not significant.

items.reason: West's O3 trough is 46.6 at 8:00 and peak is 102.1 at 18:00.

items.claim: There was no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: West's O3 weekend effect is not significant.

items.claim: Compared with July, there was no measurable change.
items.reason: West's adjusted month-on-month O3 shift is not significant.
